title: The Song of Moses

questions.question: What metaphor does Moses use for God in the song?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 32:4 (ESV): "The Rock, his work is perfect..."

questions.question: How did God find Israel?
options: In a desert land, in the howling waste of the wilderness
questions.correctAnswer: In a desert land, in the howling waste of the wilderness
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 32:10 (ESV): "He found him in a desert land, and in the howling waste of the wilderness..."

questions.question: Jeshurun grew fat and did what?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 32:15 (ESV): "But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked... he forsook God who made him..."

questions.question: What does the Lord say belongs to Him?
Where was Moses told to go to die?
options: Mount Nebo, in the land of Moab
questions.correctAnswer: Mount Nebo, in the land of Moab
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 32:49–50 (ESV): "Go up this mountain of the Abarim, Mount Nebo... and die on the mountain..."

questions.question: God describes Israel as a perverse and what generation?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 32:5 (ESV): "...they are a perverse and crooked generation."

questions.question: They stirred Him to jealousy with what?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 32:16 (ESV): "They stirred him to jealousy with strange gods..."

questions.question: How many could one chase, according to the song?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 32:30 (ESV): "How could one have chased a thousand, and two have put ten thousand to flight..."

questions.question: What is their wine compared to?
options: The poison of serpents and the cruel venom of asps
questions.correctAnswer: The poison of serpents and the cruel venom of asps
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 32:33 (ESV): "their wine is the poison of serpents and the cruel venom of asps."

questions.question: Who is the only God ("I, even I, am he")?
options: There is no god beside me
questions.correctAnswer: There is no god beside me
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 32:39 (ESV): "See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god beside me..."

questions.question: Why did God not make an end of them?
options: Lest their adversaries should say, "Our hand is triumphant, the Lord has not done all this"
questions.correctAnswer: Lest their adversaries should say, "Our hand is triumphant, the Lord has not done all this"
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 32:27 (ESV): "but I feared the provocation by the enemy... lest they should say, 'Our hand is triumphant...'"

questions.question: What incident at the waters of Meribah-kadesh prevented Moses from entering?
options: He broke faith with God and did not uphold God's holiness
questions.correctAnswer: He broke faith with God and did not uphold God's holiness
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 32:51 (ESV): "because you broke faith with me... because you did not treat me as holy..."

questions.question: God will move them to jealousy with whom?
options: Those who are no people; a foolish nation
questions.correctAnswer: Those who are no people; a foolish nation
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 32:21 (ESV): "I will move them to jealousy with those who are no people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation."

questions.question: Their vine comes from the vine of what?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 32:32 (ESV): "For their vine comes from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah..."

questions.question: When Moses finished reciting the song, what did he say the words were?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 32:47 (ESV): "For it is no empty word for you, but your very life..."

key_verse_text: The Rock, his work is perfect, for all his ways are justice. A God of faithfulness and without iniquity, just and upright is he. (ESV)
